Title: Control all Power BI Embedded visual menu actions programmatically

Body.Content:
The Options and Context Menus APIs have been extended to provide full control for each visual in the report on built-in commands and custom commands. You can hide or dim built-in commands per visual, and you can control the position of custom commands in the menus.

Read more about it on GitHub, and use the new "Insight to action" showcase in the Microsoft Power BI Embedded Playground to experience the new feature.
